title: Fujifilm Launches Synapse Pathology v3.0, Advancing the Digital Pathology Experience With Expanded AI Capabilities
description: FUJIFILM Healthcare Americas Corporation, a leading provider of diagnostic and enterprise imaging solutions, today announced the launch of Synapse ® Pathology v3.0. Featuring more than 50 new features and functions, Synapse Pathology v3.0 is designed to enhance the user experience while expanding the platform’s artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities to support the evolving needs of pathologists and laboratories. The new release will be showcased at Pathology Visions 2026 in Fujifilm booth
